scope: Research H3 state machine only; receipt admitter is a trusted stub, NOT a verified pre/mission binding
gasScope: In-test call gas including caller overhead; not total transaction fees, Gnosis deployment, or full opening proof. Forced 128 uses a test override retaining SHA; full exhaustion uses mock candidates, not a SHA preimage.
anvilMeasurementScope: Separate local transactions on a fresh private Anvil instance; initialization authenticates only the test admitter, not an opening proof. No Gnosis deployment.
